sample_uniform_quantized: sample a uniform random value from a range quantized to a step size q
sample_log_uniform_quantized: sample a log-uniform random value from a range quantized to a step size q
sample_power2_uniform_quantized: sample a uniform power of 2 value from a range quantized to q
sample_normal_quantized: sample a clipped normal Gaussian value from a range quantized to a step size q
plot_rand_cdf: plot the cumulative distribution function of a random sampling distribution for validation
